_about: Eval rules (ADR 007): hand-written KQL run by `python -m opssoc.replay seed --eval-rules`. They are loosened versions of detection_As_Code endpoint rules, so they match both the recorded attacks and recorded background activity the real rules leave out. They exist to give the eval harness benign cases; they are not detections and are never deployed.

rules.name: reg.exe saved or exported an HKLM registry key
rules.description: reg.exe with save or export and an HKLM path. Loosened from detection_As_Code A3, which only matches the SAM, SYSTEM and SECURITY hive roots. Grouped per host, account and parent process.

sentinel.query:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4688 and NewProcessName endswith @"\reg.exe"
| where CommandLine has_any ("save", "export") and CommandLine has "HKLM"
| summarize TimeGenerated = min(TimeGenerated), Commands = count(),
    CommandLine = min(CommandLine) by Computer, Account, NewProcessName, ParentProcessName

rules.name: Registry Run key value set
rules.description: Sysmon event 13 setting a value under a Run, RunOnce, RunOnceEx, RunServices or Policies\Explorer\Run key, by any process. detection_As_Code A2 without its installer, Program Files and Defender exclusions.

sentinel.query:
Event
| where Source == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 13
| extend Data = parse_xml(EventData).DataItem.EventData.Data
| mv-apply d = Data on (summarize Fields = make_bag(bag_pack(tostring(d["@Name"]), tostring(d["#text"]))))
| extend EventType = tostring(Fields.EventType), Image = tostring(Fields.Image),
    TargetObject = tostring(Fields.TargetObject), Details = tostring(Fields.Details)
| where EventType == "SetValue"
| where TargetObject matches regex @"(?i)\\Software\\(Wow6432Node\\)?Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\(Run|RunOnce|RunOnceEx|RunServices|RunServicesOnce|Policies\\Explorer\\Run)\\"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, UserName, Image, TargetObject, Details
